newsitem.title: USA: Pride Petroleum Services Q1 oper shr up.
newsitem.headline: Pride Petroleum Services Q1 oper shr up.

text.p: (Amounts in Thousands Expect Earnings Per Share Data)
NOTE: The full name of the company is Pride Petroleum Services Inc.

Net earnings include a gain on the disposal of the company's U.S. land-based well servicing business of $54,568,000, net of tax. The gain was partially offset by a charge of $13,300,000, net of tax, for costs expected to be incurred in connection with the combination of the business units of Forasol-Foramer with the Company's existing operations, a charge of $4,648,000 relating to the induced conversion of $28,000,000 principal amount of the company's 6-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures, and a charge of $288,000, net of tax, for estimated costs to be incurred in winding down the company's operations in Russia.

Excluding non-recurring items, net earnings were $8,589,000, or $0.23 per share for the quarter. For the same period in 1996, Pride reported net earnings of $2,780,000, or $0.11 per share, on revenues of $66,235,000.
